mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO TBL_ELIMINATION_VOUCHER ( VOUCHER_ID, MODEL_ID, TEMPLATE_ID, PERIOD, VOUCHER_NO, VOUCHER_DATE, ENTRY_TYPE, ACCOUNT_CODE, ACCOUNT_NAME, AMOUNT, ORG_ID, ORG_NAME, DESCRIPTION, STATUS, TENANT_ID, CREATE_USER, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_USER, UPDATE_TIME ) VALUES
( #{item.voucherId}, #{item.modelId}, #{item.templateId}, #{item.period}, #{item.voucherNo}, #{item.voucherDate}, #{item.entryType}, #{item.accountCode}, #{item.accountName}, #{item.amount}, #{item.orgId}, #{item.orgName}, #{item.description}, #{item.status}, #{item.tenantId}, #{item.createUser}, #{item.createTime}, #{item.updateUser}, #{item.updateTime} )
mapper.select: SELECT v.VOUCHER_ID, v.MODEL_ID, v.TEMPLATE_ID, v.PERIOD, v.VOUCHER_NO, v.VOUCHER_DATE, v.ENTRY_TYPE, v.ACCOUNT_CODE, v.ACCOUNT_NAME, v.AMOUNT, v.ORG_ID, v.ORG_NAME, v.DESCRIPTION, v.STATUS, v.TENANT_ID, v.CREATE_USER, v.CREATE_TIME, v.UPDATE_USER, v.UPDATE_TIME, m.MODEL_NAME, t.TEMPLATE_NAME FROM TBL_ELIMINATION_VOUCHER v LEFT JOIN TBL_CONSOLIDATION_MODEL m ON v.MODEL_ID = m.MODEL_ID LEFT JOIN TBL_ELIMINATION_TEMPLATE t ON v.TEMPLATE_ID = t.TEMPLATE_ID WHERE v.VOUCHER_NO = #{voucherNo} ORDER BY v.ENTRY_TYPE DESC, v.CREATE_TIME ASC
